Data.String: CIP (D-021, D-037): pre-rinse from T-224, NaOH about 2 wt% at 353 K for 30 min from T-221, rinse from T-223, nitric acid about 1 wt% weekly from T-222, final rinse recovered to T-224; one fermenter at a time (ASSUMED). AIT-2203 and TT-2204 switch the recovery valves (caustic to T-221, rinse to T-224, else drain).
P-222A/B self-priming, at the low point of the return header below the fermenter rows (S1#9, ASSUMED). Tank levels, vents and overflows: level transmitters at detail; vents to atmosphere as drawn.

SIP steam (S1#10, ASSUMED): plant LP steam, saturated, dryness 0.95 or better after the header separator of the utility area, through 1 um sintered filters F-231A/B (duty, standby; PDI-2206), PV-2205 (fail closed) holds 1.5 barg in 150-SS-2019, below every vessel design pressure and disc set point (PAH 1.8 barg, D-037); drip legs with traps at the low points; condensate to the drain (D-021).
